_description: The fighters lab's own numbers (tools/nn/fighters, docs/en/training/fighters_lab.md). Everything else comes from the game's database through the simulator's params (config/nn/game_rules.json, units.json) and its rules (config/nn/sim.json). Outside tools/nn/sim and config/nn on purpose: the lab does not change the simulator's version.

cells.why: the neighbour search (cells.py): a man sees every man within cell_m (3 x 3 cells round his own) - the reach 2.5 m (entity_action_attack_formed_combat_distance) + the largest body radius of our roster 0.9 (wolf rats) is 3.4; cap: men a cell holds at most (the densest close order, Empire infantry 1.48 x 1.6 m, ~5.5 a cell; a melee crush ~2x); hash: the cell table per battle (a power of 2)

standoff.why: MEASURED, not a rule of the game (none found in CA's material, the database or the community): how close a man in a fight stands to the enemy man he fights. The probes' soldiers' places once a second (reform, reform2, damaged, dmgmelee, wave, armour: 48 lanes, build/charge-probe/runs; shape.py front_gap: the median nearest-enemy distance of the 15 men nearest the enemy) - 0.98 / 1.14 / 1.32 / 1.51 / 1.91 / 2.24 / 2.26 / 2.39 m at 0-1 / 1-3 / 3-5 / 5-10 / 10-20 / 20-40 / 40-90 / 90-240 s after contact: d(t) = steady - (steady - start) exp(-t / tau), t the pair's seconds in melee (the younger of the two units' melee clocks, as the simulator's melee.wave). The men within reach of the enemy (and so the blows) follow from it; they are what the lab is checked by.

move.front_only_why: only a man of the formation's front rank (its foremost places; after an about-face the old back rank) with an enemy man in reach takes the standoff from him; the men behind keep their places (they still strike whatever is in their reach). With every man in reach closing on an enemy, the second rank pushed the first into the enemy: the probes' men within reach 34-45 against the game's 19 at 20-40 s after contact, the fronts 1.1-1.4 m apart against 2.3 (build/fighters/probes_a.json).

free.why: a beast's men fight free (move.free_attack): once one man of his unit has an enemy within reach, under an attack order, each man leaves his place and closes on an enemy man (the one he fights or the nearest within reach + the tether, no tether to his place), else runs at his unit's target's centre - the bodies stop him at its men and the rest flow round it. A beast: an ellipse body (battle_entities radii_ratio < 1) and no missile weapon (in the roster: the wolf rats; the database's kv_rules carry both 'formed' and 'free' attack modes - matched_combat_formed_vs_free_percentage, max_range_for_attack_mode_free_attack 100 m - but no table says which unit fights which way, so the rule is by body). MEASURED on the wolf rats' probe lanes (plans wolfrats, wolfpoison: 4 battles, 22 lanes on swordsmen, spearmen, the General; build/charge-probe/runs/20261011-2141..2145): the game's rats within reach (3.15 m) of the enemy 46-77 of 80 at 1-3 s after contact, wrapped round its flanks (wrap 0.1-0.7); the formed lab 15-20 (only the front rank, the ranks 3.5 m apart), 46-78 with this. The rats' melee damage sim / game (sum over lanes) 5-15 s 0.32 -> 1.13, steady 0.41 -> 0.87; the HP the rats lose 5-15 s 0.75 -> 1.34, steady 1.35 -> 1.92 (the same overshoot in big crowds as units mobbed by 3+ enemy units, docs: 'Mobs'). Replay of the 2 exam battles from the places: melee damage on whole units 1.10 -> 1.14.

hold.why: OFF. on: a man with an enemy man within reach (F.tgt) of a standing unit of 2+ is not carried by his unit's centre (move.held, hook._post) and keeps where he stands - a front man at the standoff from the man he fights with no tether - while his place is within release_m (null: any distance). Tried on the replay of the 2 exam battles from the places (build/night5, churndata.py, jump filter 5 m): 'still in reach 3 s later' (standing units) 0.80 -> 0.85 (game 0.82), but 0.83 -> 0.90 when the unit's centre stands (game 0.82) and no gain when it moves > 6 m in 3 s (0.67 -> 0.68, game 0.77); killed per HP lost 0.74 -> 0.77 (release 5 m: 0.79; game 0.79), melee HP on whole units 1.15 -> 1.32 (1.30). Rejected: the damage.

move.tether_all_why: OFF. true: a man behind the front with an enemy man within reach (F.tgt) stands where he is while within the database's entity_action_attack_formed_tether_distance (2 m) of his place, beyond it he is pulled to the tether's edge; false: he walks to his place (the bodies push him off it again: at a standing centre the lab's fighting men walk 0.36 m and are pushed 0.22 m a 0.5 s step). Tried on the replay of the 2 exam battles from the places (build/night5/tall): a man in reach moves 1.64 -> 1.39 m in 3 s at a standing centre (game 0.73), still in reach 0.80 -> 0.82 (game 0.82), the same nearest enemy still in reach 0.55 -> 0.60 (game 0.67), killed per HP lost 0.75 -> 0.76 (game 0.79; from the window's 5th second 0.86 -> 0.87), melee HP on whole units 1.14 -> 1.19. Too little for the damage: kept off.
move.front_anchor_why: a formation keeps its ranks behind its fighting front: its places shift along its facing by the mean way its men with an enemy in reach stand off their own places (at most 3 m; back to 0 by half a step once none fights). Without it the front men could not step back to the standoff - the men behind them held them - and the fronts parted slower than the game's (front gap 1.43 / 1.78 m against 1.97 / 2.32 at 10-20 / 20-40 s; men within reach 40 / 34 against 27 / 19).
move.in_reach_only_why: only a man with an enemy man within his reach (the one he strikes) takes his standoff; the men behind keep their places (pushed back by the bodies in front). With every man within reach + the tether closing on an enemy, the second rank kept pushing the first into the enemy: the probes' men within reach 45 against the game's 19 at 20-40 s after contact (build/fighters/probes_a.json).
move.why: a man walks to his place in the formation (his file and rank, re-formed as men fall: the man behind steps up, the file closes up) at his unit's run speed relative to the unit's centre; in a fight he stands at the standoff from the enemy he fights, at most the database's entity_action_attack_formed_tether_distance (2.0 m) from his place; bodies (the database's radius) do not overlap. A formation that turns about (more than 90 deg in a step) swaps its ranks and files, as the game's about-face in place (the simulator's turn rule).

melee.why: a man's attack interval (the passport's) runs after a hit, a miss costs the simulator's melee.miss_s (CA Feature Focus #2: the interval runs after a blow); his clock runs only while an enemy is within his reach, so a man's first blow of the battle is at once (the first strike) and a unit coming back into a fight brings no new burst (the recontact probe: the second contact's first 3 s 0.24-1.35 of the steady rate, the first 2.87).
melee.blow_share_why: 1: no share (the swing per interval above is the game's own clock). Before: 0.35 measured as the game's HP per man in reach over the formula with a 0.5 s miss (116 lane-sides, by pair 0.2-0.65); the per-pair spread follows p: the swing clock p / interval against p / (p interval + 0.5) is p + 0.5 / interval.
melee.swing_per_interval_why: every swing, hit or miss, starts an attack interval after the last (CA's schema of melee_weapons: the interval is 'the smallest gap between the starts of attack animations'; the community: 'one attack each 3.8 s'). MEASURED on the swing probe (charge_probe plan 'swing', build/charge-probe/runs/20261016-213837: units cut to 5 and 1 men, both attacking, health and places every 0.1 s; tools/nn/fighters/swingdata.py): 91 hits (77 drops of health) in 1,020 man-seconds within reach, the per-swing clock p / interval expects 76, the simulator's miss of 0.5 s (p / (p interval + 0.5)) 167 - game / per swing 1.20 [+-0.21] by hits, 1.01 by drops; game / miss 0.5 s 0.55. The 0.35 'share of blows' was this: a miss costs the whole interval (and the simulator's 121-battle fit of miss_s 0.5 s came with its fighting_files 0.5). With it the melee probes' target HP 15-30 s / steady sum sim / game 1.00 / 1.02 (0.35 share: 0.92 / 0.92). Battle 2 of the plan (units of 25, build/charge-probe/runs/20261016-232843): 551 hits, per swing expects 441 (1.25; drops 1.04), miss 0.5 s 959 (0.57).
melee.unit_incidental_why: a man of a unit whose attack order is on another enemy unit strikes this one with this share of his blows (the lab's own number; the simulator's contact.unit_incidental 1.0 stays for the rectangle). MEASURED on the soldiers' places of 2 exam v2 battles (seed 1000700001, the net itS26_15 v the game's AI, build/nn-arena/runs/20261017-041216, -041729; build/fighters2/game_rate.py): a unit's HP lost a second against the enemy men within reach of its men, least squares over 16.6k unit-seconds - a man of a unit targeting another unit 0.35-0.53 of one whose unit targets this (0.52 / 0.99 with one enemy unit in reach, 0.32 / 0.73 two, 0.20 / 0.52 three or more). With 0.45 the replay from the places: melee damage on whole units 1.23 -> 1.10, units reached by 1 / 2 / 3+ enemy units 1.15 / 1.24 / 1.46 -> 1.04 / 1.05 / 1.33.
melee.pairs_why: OFF (null) until the user decides: killed per HP lost falls (morale counts the men), the lab step costs +33 % (1024 battles 21.1 -> 28.1 ms), K is chosen partly by the result, and the crowd probe (5 rats surrounded) found no cap on attackers. K: an enemy man is fought by at most K men at a time (a lone man - a lord - by any number; the simulator's contact.lord_max_attackers stays for him). The victim keeps first the men who fought him last step, then the men whose unit's attack target is his unit, then the nearest; a man left over takes the nearest enemy man in reach who still has room (pairs_repair: the step's melee scan over the men with room, K rounds), else he waits - no swing, his clock stands (as out of reach). null: off. MEASURED on the game's soldiers' places (2 exam v2 battles, build/nn-arena/runs/20261017-041216, -041729; victim-seconds whose every striker's unit targets the victim): the HP lost over the formula of one striker per enemy man in reach falls 0.85 -> 0.44 as the strikers per victim reached rise 1.3 -> 4.6, over the formula times the disjoint striker-victim pairs with at most 2 strikers a victim it stays 0.61-0.69 (1 a victim: 0.79-1.05); the lab without the rule 1.5 -> 2.4 times those pairs. The database names a second attacker on one target (melee_secondary_attack_probability 1) and no third. Replay of those 2 battles from the places (build/agent-mobs) K off / 1 / 2 / 3: melee HP on whole units 1.16 / - / 0.99 / 1.06, units reached by 1 / 2 / 3+ enemy units 1.28 / 1.16 / 1.46 -> 0.92 / 0.79 / 0.92 (K 1), 1.12 / 0.97 / 1.18 (K 2), 1.18 / 1.07 / 1.31 (K 3); routs 1.09 -> 1.00 (K 2); without the re-pairing (pairs_repair false, K 2) 0.95 / 0.85 / 1.00, whole units 0.84. But killed per HP lost 0.72 -> 0.48 (K 1: 0.33, K 3: 0.55; game 1): the game's blows stay concentrated on fewer men - open. Step replay itS26_15 (10 battles, the lab's own places): melee HP 1.15 -> 1.08, killed per HP 0.91 -> 0.71, routs 1.03 -> 0.97. Melee probes (53 lanes with the crowd's): target HP 0-1 / 0-5 / 5-15 s / steady 1.45 / 1.13 / 0.80 / 0.98 -> 1.25 / 1.03 / 0.80 / 0.98 (mean log error lower in every bin), the target's men 0-10 s 1.33 -> 1.04, the attacker's men 0-10 s 0.80 -> 0.56.
melee.max_attackers_why: OFF (null). K: a man takes the blows of at most K of the men in reach fighting him (each one's blow lands with the chance K / n, n of them on him; not on a lone man). Candidate for the mobs (kv_rules melee_max_hit_reactions 2): the game's melee probes (112 lanes, 13-40 s after contact) deal per striker within reach over the formula 0.98 / 0.87 / 0.71 / 0.58 / 0.42 / 0.34 / 0.18 with < 10 / 10-20 / 20-30 / 30-45 / 45-60 / 60-90 / 90+ strikers in reach - the lab's rate per striker does not fall; K = 2 flattens it to 1.08 / 1.06 / 0.97 / 0.88 / 0.65 / 0.58 / 0.35. Melee probes with K = 2: target HP 0-1 / 0-5 / 0-10 s 1.59 / 1.40 / 1.24 -> 1.33 / 1.14 / 1.01, steady 1.07 -> 0.96, 5-15 s 0.97 -> 0.78. Rejected: the replay of the 2 exam battles from the places - melee damage on whole units 1.10 -> 0.79, killed per HP lost 0.74 -> 0.52 (game 0.79: the cap spreads the blows over more men), units reached by 1 / 2 / 3+ enemy units 1.05 / 1.05 / 1.34 -> 0.82 / 0.70 / 0.91.
melee.direction_why: the side a blow comes from (front / flank / rear: the defence penalty): 'man' - the striker seen from the struck man against his own facing (to the man he fights); 'unit' - against his unit's facing; 'unit_centre' - the striker's unit centre from the struck unit's centre (the rectangle's way). Checked on the replay from the game's places (2 exam battles, melee damage on whole units sim/game): man 1.23, unit 1.29, unit_centre 1.19; units reached by 3+ enemy units 1.46 / 1.55 / 1.44; melee probes the same (steady 1.01-1.02). The direction does not explain the mobs' excess; 'man' kept.
melee.prefer_target_why: true: a man of his unit's attack target counts 2 m nearer when he picks whom to strike (scans.melee_scan); false: the nearest. Tried for the whole battles' split (the replay of the 2 exam battles from the game's places, victim-seconds with every striker's unit targeting the victim, not moving, not fresh: lab / game 1.60; every striker's unit targeting another: 0.50): off 1.51 / 0.54, all 1.22 -> 1.19 (with unit_incidental 1 too: 1.52 / 0.89, all 1.35) - no help, kept on.
melee.reach_radius_why: true: a man reaches an enemy man whose centre is within the formed combat distance (2.5 m, database) plus that man's radius; false: 2.5 m centre to centre (the database does not say which). Tried (build/night_mob/reach25, probes_reach25): the replay of the 2 exam battles from the places - melee HP on whole units 1.14 -> 0.92, the own-target victims 1.60 -> 1.19, units reached by 80+ enemy men 1.63 -> 1.33, but killed per HP lost 0.75 -> 0.66 (game 0.79); the melee probes (53 lanes with the crowd lanes) target HP 0-1 s 1.45 -> 1.12, 5-15 s 0.80 -> 0.63, steady 0.98 -> 0.90. Mixed: kept on.
melee.clear_line_why: OFF. true: a man strikes only when no living man of his own side stands in the way to the man he fights (that man's body, his radius, crosses the segment between them; melee.blocked_line) - a second rank in reach does not strike past its front rank, his clock stands. The game's places (2 exam battles, build/nn-arena/runs/20261017-041216, -041729; victim-seconds, least squares of the HP lost on the enemy men in reach split clear / blocked by a friend within 0.6 m of the line): per clear man 0.78, per blocked -0.46 (x1e-4 of the unit a second) - the blocked add nothing; 30 % of the game's men in reach are blocked, 30-40 % of the lab's. Tried on the replay of those 2 battles from the places (build/night3, reachlog.py): melee HP on whole units 1.15 -> 0.84 (with unit_incidental 1: 0.95), the own-target victims 1.54 -> 1.16 (1.17), the other-target 0.52 -> 0.38 (0.61), but killed per HP lost 0.75 -> 0.60 (0.63; game 0.79) - the blows spread over more men; the melee probes (53 lanes with the crowd's, unit_incidental 1) target HP 0-1 / 0-5 / 5-15 s 1.45 / 1.13 / 0.80 -> 1.01 / 0.82 / 0.71, steady 0.98 -> 0.99; kept off.
melee.pick_why: whom a man strikes among the enemy men in reach (melee.resolve): 'nearest' - the one he fights while in reach, else the nearest (his unit's attack target 2 m nearer, prefer_target); 'score' - hypothesis M3 (melee.pick_score): of the cands nearest men in reach the highest 1 / rank by distance + front within front_deg of his facing (+ side within side_deg) + attacker if that man's unit attacks his unit, the man he fought last step x keep; facing 'man': to the man he fought, else his unit's. Not a database number: candidate for the game's blows gathering on fewer men (killed per HP lost 0.72 of the game).
melee.chase_charge_why: null: a blow on a routing man has no charge bonus (the simulator's pursuit rule). A number: such a blow carries the striker's whole charge bonus (attack and damage) with this chance, else none. MEASURED on the pursuitfast probe (build/charge-probe/runs/20261020-002609: stormvermin chasing spearmen, wolf rats chasing swordsmen, the target's health every 0.1 s): a single blow of stormvermin on spearmen standing 15 s after contact .. the rout 26-30 HP (no charge: 28.4 by the rule), in the chase two kinds only - 26-30 and 41-46 (the whole charge bonus 18: 43.4), none decayed in between; 36 of 68 single chase blows (no man died in the 0.1 s) carry the charge (0.53), the database's pursuit_charge_bonus_modifier 1 (the wolf rats' chase: 22 full-charge blows of 41-43 HP against 9 of 14-15, many 26-28 - two blows in one sample or a part charge, not told apart). Off until the pursuit's share (contact.pursuit_rate 0.43, fitted with no charge) is measured again.
melee.start_phase_why: false: every man is ready to swing when he first meets the enemy - the swing probe battle 2 (tools/nn/fighters/openingdata.py): the game's hits by 1 / 2 / 3 s after contact over this model 1.22 / 1.41 / 1.50, over a random point of the interval 6.85 / 3.54 / 2.42, over a 0.5 / 1 s delay 1.72 / 4.67 at 1 s.

knock.invulnerable_why: a man lying (knocked down) strikes nobody, nobody strikes him and no projectile or blast takes his health: the simulator's magic.knock reading (build/magic/probe2.md: lone men under the spells - with it the twin's damage 0.85 / 1.38 of the game, without 1.39 / 3.66) and the community (knocked-down infantry outlive what would kill them: steamcommunity WH3 'Realistic Charge' comments). Checked man by man on the knock probe (magic battle 6, build/magic/runs/20261016-211346, knockdata.py): of the men thrown, none died lying - 0 deaths in 778 man-seconds lying, while the men up near the strikes died at 0.005-0.020 a second (~11 deaths expected); the swordsmen in melee with clanrats, 31 of 106 thrown by Warp Lightning, took 20 / 13 HP a second off the clanrats 3-6 / 6-12 s after the strike against the control lane's 48 / 33 (the strike killed some of them too).

throw.why: how far the impact throws a man knocked back or down: median_m x exp(N(0, sigma_log)), at most max_m. MEASURED, no database number: the knock probe (magic battle 6, build/magic/runs/20261016-211346; soldiers' places every 0.1 s, each man followed, tools/nn/fighters/knockdata.py) - his move from his place before the strike to where he first stops, median / p10 / p90: Searing Doom on clanrats 3.26 / 2.29 / 6.04 m (208 men thrown of 537 in 4 strikes), on skavenslaves 3.20 / 2.27 / 7.24 (197 of 421), Warp Lightning on swordsmen 2.97 / 1.35 / 9.02 (70 of 244), on swordsmen in melee 2.80 / 1.58 / 4.74 (45 of 165); the same for both spells and every target, so one distribution (sigma from p10-p90 of Searing Doom: ln(6 / 2.3) / 2.56); the direction mostly away from the strike (cosine with the line from it: median 0.5-0.7); the control lane (no cast) had no strike. The old '1.5-3 m' (1 s places) held the men's ordinary moves.

missile.path_full_why: missile.path_full (missile.py _trace, kernels.path_first; false: path_points for every projectile): each projectile searches its whole low path for bodies - the battle's tallest body's height / tan theta + its widest radius back from the landing point, no farther than the shooter - in cell_m steps, at most path_points_max (48 x 3.6 = 173 m, past the longest range of the roster, 160 m: a cap, not a fitted number). A counting error before: path_points' 6 x 3.6 = 21.6 m cut a flat bullet's low path (h / tan theta: 37 m at 100 m, 61 m at 60 m for a man 1.8 m tall and the 100 m/s bullet), so a bullet that passed over its aim man and came down onto the ranks behind him past 21.6 m was a miss.
missile.own_pass_why: a projectile passes the men of its shooter's own unit (kernels.path_first: only enemy men and the men of other units stop it); false: every man but the shooter himself. MEASURED on the shots probe (missile_probe plan shots, build/missile-probe/runs/20261019-161711): handgunners (90 men, 30 m wide) at a lone Warlock Engineer 27 m off - hits a shot game 0.736, lab with the own ranks in the way 0.051 (a flat bullet aimed at a man's middle comes down ~60 m beyond him: at 27 m it is under 1.2 m high over its own front ranks), with own_pass 0.735; every other probe lane the same either way (crossbows at 27 m 0.437 / 0.436, game 0.352; 100-137 m lanes, the ratform / ratling formations unchanged).
missile.why: projectiles a battle traced per step at most (the rest wait for the next step), the points along a projectile's low path searched for bodies (cells.cell_m apart from the landing point back towards the shooter: 6 x 3.6 = 21.6 m; a flat shot's longer low path is cut there), projectiles a man looses per step at most
